name: docs-naming
description: File-name toolkit that plans, applies, and enforces a casing rule across a tracked tree: setup (the one configuration file), audit-file-names (read-only inventory plus the reference sweep, writing the rename plan), realign-file-names (the executor, one human acceptance per file), and generate-file-name-gate (emits the standalone check that keeps the tree from drifting back).

file_names.title: Your file-name settings (JSON)
file_names.description: Your file_names keys as one JSON object, the shape of docs/conventions/docs-naming.yaml, e.g. {"exempt_basenames":["NOTES.md"]}. Empty (default): none. Repository files win; on policy-floor keys it only adds, and generated is ignored. Invalid JSON is reported and ignored.
